40014378.author: पदार्थः
40014378.content: राक्षसेन्द्रेण: to the leader of Rakshasas, सर्वे: all Rakshasas, महाबलाः of mighty strength प्रान्जलयः greeting with folded hand s, राक्षसास्ते: the Rakshasas, राक्षसेश्वरम्: Lord of Rakshasas, रावणं: to Ravana ऊचुः having heard, इत्युक्ता: thus spoke.

40014378.author: Translation
40014378.content: All the Rakshasas of mighty strength, having heard the Lord of Rakshasas, thus spoke to their leader, greeting with folded hands.

40014379.author: पदार्थः
40014379.content: राजन्: o king परिघ: iron bars, शक्त्यृष्टि: javelins, शूलपट्टि: arrows, and swords, शकुन्तलम्: sharp edged spears, द्विषत्पक्षम: double edged swords, अविज्ञाय: not  knowing, नीतिबाह्या: political intelligence, स्त्वबुद्धयः submitted by themselves.

40014379.author: Translation
40014379.content: "O King The ogres are not having political intelligence. They have submitted themselves, even though they are mighty and are having iron bars, javelins, sharp edged spears, and doubleedged swords."

40014380.author: पदार्थः
40014380.content: इत्युक्ता: having spoken thus, राक्षसेन्द्रेण: by the Lord of Rakshasas, राक्षसास्ते    (तेराक्षसा ): those Rakshasa, महाबलाः who were very strong, द्विषत्पक्षं: the enemy's side अविज्ञाय: ignorant about, नीतिबाह्या: without having political wisdom,  (नीतिबाह्यास्त्वबुद्धयःनीतिबाह्या:  तु  अबुद्धय:) अबुद्धय: not intelligent, ऊचुः told, प्रान्जलयः with folded hands, रावणं: to Ravana, राक्षसेश्वरम्: the king of Rakshasas.

40014380.author: Translation
40014380.content: The Lord of Rakshasas having spoken like that, to the Rakshasas, who were very strong, but ignorant about the enemy's strength and who were not endowed with political wisdom, spoke to Ravana, the king of Rakshasas, the following words with folded hands.

40014381.author: पदार्थः
40014381.content: राजन्: Oh king, परिघ: iron bars, शक्ति: javelins, ऋष्टि: double edged swords, शूल: spear, पट्टिश: spear with a sharp edge or some other weapon with three points, कुन्तलम्: ploughs.

40014381.author: Translation
40014381.content: "Oh king, (our army is equipped with) iron bars, javelins, double edged swords, spears, three pointed weapons, ploughs etc."

40014382.author: पदार्थः
40014382.content: सुमहन्नोबलं: mighty army strength, कस्माद्: why, विषादं: despondent भजते: give way भवान्: you, त्वया: by you पन्नगा: Nagas, युधि: in war, भोगवतीं: Bhogavathi, गत्वा: going, निर्जिताः subdued

40014382.author: Translation
40014382.content: "Why are you despondent? You have huge and mighty army strength. When you went to Bhogavathi, the Nagas were subdued in war by your mighty army."

40014383.author: पदार्थः
40014383.content: कैलासशिखरावासी: he who lives on the peak of mount Kailas: बहुभि: numerous, यक्षै: Yakshas, (बहुभि:  आवृत:  बाहुभिरावृत:) आवृतः surrounded by, सुमहत: great, कदनं: sorrow कृत्वा: being caused, वश्यस्ते: surrendered to you, धनदः bestow er of wealth (Kubera) कृतः remained.

40014383.author: Translation
40014383.content: He who dwells on the peak of Mount Kailasa, surrounded by numerous yakshas, was, after great affliction was visited upon him, made to submit to you.

40014384.author: पदार्थः
40014384.content: स: that, महेश्वरसख्येन: by the friendship of Maheswara (Siva), श्लाघमान: priding महाबलः strong, ल्लोकपालो: ruler of the world, स्त्वया: by you might, विभो: O king, निर्जितः subdued, समरे: in conflict.

40014384.author: Translation
40014384.content: "O King Proud of his friendship with Lord Maheshwara (Siva), that mighty ruler of the world Kubera was subdued by you in the conflict."

40014385.author: पदार्थः
40014385.content: त्वया: by you, यक्षौघान्: hordes of yaksha, विनिहत्य: taking as prisoners, विक्षोभ्यच: causing disturbance by stirring and, विनिगृह्यच: and taking away, कैलासशिखराद्: from mount Kailas, विमानमिदमाहृतम्: brought this great aerial chariot.

40014385.author: Translation
40014385.content: "Causing terrific disturbance to the hordes of Yakshas and taking them as prisoners, you have brought the great aerial chariot from mount Kailas."

40014386.author: पदार्थः
40014386.content: राक्षसपुङ्गव: leader of Rakshasas, दानवेन्द्रेण: ruler of Danavas, मयेन: by Maya, त्वद्भयात्: out of fear of you, मिच्छता: sought, सख्य: alliance, दत्ता: given तव: to you, भार्यार्थे: wife, दुहिता: daughter.

40014386.author: Translation
40014386.content: "Maya, the ruler of Danavas has given his daughter (Mandodari) to you as a wife out of fear of you, O leader of Rakshasas"

40014387.author: पदार्थः
40014387.content: दुरासदः difficult to approach, वीर्योत्सिक्तो: proud of his valour, कुम्भीनस्याः Kumbhinasi (your sister), सुखावहः who brings joy to her (who is husband of), दानवेन्द्रो: ruler of Danavas, मधुर्नाम: called as Madhu, विगृह्य: offering to fight and win, वशमानीतः subjugated to you.

40014387.author: Translation
40014387.content: "Madhu, another ruler of Danavas who was proud of his valour and difficult to approach, the husband of Kumbhinasi was subjugated by you by your offering to fight with him."

40014388.author: पदार्थः
40014388.content: महाबाहो: mighty armed, स्ते: you गत्वा: going to, रसातलम्: subterranean region वासुकि:: Vasuki, तक्षकः Takshaka, शङखो: Shanka, जटीच: and Jati, नागा: serpent demons, र्जिता: winning over, वशमाहृताः made them submit to you.

40014388.author: Translation
40014388.content: "O mighty armed king Going to the subterranean world, you won over the serpent demons Vasuki, Takshaka, Shanka and Jati and made them submit to you."

40014389.author: पदार्थः
40014389.content: अक्षया: imperishable, बलवन्तश्च: strong and mighty, शूरा: warriors, लब्धवराः who had obtained boon, त्वया: by you, संवत्सरं: one year, युद्ध्वा: fighting, पुनः again, समरे: in war, दानवा: Danavas, विभो: Oh Lord.

40014389.author: Translation
40014389.content: "The mighty and strong Danava warriors who had obtained boon were made to fight a war by you for one year."

40014390.author: पदार्थः
40014390.content: राक्षसाधिप: king of Rakshasas, स्वबलं: your own strength, समुपाश्रित्य: resorting to, मायाश्च: deceitful tricks, अधिगता: learned, तत्र: there, बह्वो: many, नीता: reduced to, वशम: sub mission, अरिन्दम: subduer of enemies.

40014390.author: Translation
40014390.content: "O king of Rakshasas (Those Danavas) were reduced to sub mission by resorting to your own strength. Oh subduer of enemies, many deceitful tricks were learned from them."

40014391.author: पदार्थः
40014391.content: महाभाग: blessed one, चतुर्विधबलानुगाः four kinds of army, शूराश्च: capable heroes, बलवन्तश्च: mighty strong, वरुणस्य: Varuna's, सुता: sons, रणे: in war, निर्जिता: have won, ते: by you.

40014391.author: Translation
40014391.content: "O blessed king Mighty strong sons of Varuna, heroes capable of war and of all the four kinds of army have been won by you."

40014392.author: पदार्थः
40014392.content: मृत्युदण्ड: Yama's rod of death, महाग्राहं: huge alligator, शाल्मलिद्रुममण्डितम्: adorned with Salmali trees (bristling with thorns to be used as weapons), कालपाश: noose of time (Kala), महावीचिं: hugely turbulent wave, यमकिंकरपन्नगम्: Lord of death 's attendants as serpents, महाज्वरेण: on account of mighty Jwara (spirit of fever), दुर्धर्षं: unassailable, यमलोकमहार्णवम्: ocean in the shape of Yama's realm, अवगाह्य: plunging into. त्वया: by you, राजन्: Oh King, यमस्य: realm of death, बलसागरम्: ocean of army, जयश्च: victory, विपुल: great, प्राप्तो: obtained, मृत्युश्च: and death, प्रतिषेधितः warded off, सुयुद्धेनच: and by good battle, ते: your, सर्वे: all, लोका: people (of that world), तत्र: there, सुतोषिताः were delighted.

40014392.author: Translation
40014392.content: "Oh King Plunging into the ocean, which was in the shape of Yama's realm, with an enormous alligator in the form of rod of death, adorned with Salmali trees, turbulent with a huge wave in the form of Death 's noose, infested with Lord of  Death's attendants as serpents, unassailable on account of the mighty Jwara (spirit of fever), you have obtained a great victory over the Lord of Death 's great army and the army was warded off. By your good battle all the people (of the world) were delighted.

40014393.author: पदार्थः
40014393.content: मृत्युदण्ड: Yama's rod of death, महाग्राहं: huge alligator, शाल्मलिद्रुममण्डितम्: adorned with Salmali trees (bristling with thorns to be used as weapons), कालपाश: noose of time (Kala), महावीचिं: hugely turbulent wave, यमकिंकरपन्नगम्: Lord of death 's attendants as serpents, महाज्वरेण: on account of mighty Jwara (spirit of fever), दुर्धर्षं: unassailable, यमलोकमहार्णवम्: ocean in the shape of Yama's realm, अवगाह्य: plunging into. त्वया: by you, राजन्: Oh King, यमस्य: realm of death, बलसागरम्: ocean of army, जयश्च: victory, विपुल: great, प्राप्तो: obtained, मृत्युश्च: and death, प्रतिषेधितः warded off, सुयुद्धेनच: and by good battle, ते: your, सर्वे: all, लोका: people (of that world), तत्र: there, सुतोषिताः were delighted.

40014393.author: Translation
40014393.content: "Oh King Plunging into the ocean, which was in the shape of Yama's realm, with an enormous alligator in the form of rod of death, adorned with Salmali trees, turbulent with a huge wave in the form of Death 's noose, infested with Lord of  Death's attendants as serpents, unassailable on account of the mighty Jwara (spirit of fever), you have obtained a great victory over the Lord of Death 's great army and the army was warded off. By your good battle all the people (of the world) were delighted.

40014394.author: पदार्थः
40014394.content: मृत्युदण्ड: Yama's rod of death, महाग्राहं: huge alligator, शाल्मलिद्रुममण्डितम्: adorned with Salmali trees (bristling with thorns to be used as weapons), कालपाश: noose of time (Kala), महावीचिं: hugely turbulent wave, यमकिंकरपन्नगम्: Lord of death 's attendants as serpents, महाज्वरेण: on account of mighty Jwara (spirit of fever), दुर्धर्षं: unassailable, यमलोकमहार्णवम्: ocean in the shape of Yama's realm, अवगाह्य: plunging into. त्वया: by you, राजन्: Oh King, यमस्य: realm of death, बलसागरम्: ocean of army, जयश्च: victory, विपुल: great, प्राप्तो: obtained, मृत्युश्च: and death, प्रतिषेधितः warded off, सुयुद्धेनच: and by good battle, ते: your, सर्वे: all, लोका: people (of that world), तत्र: there, सुतोषिताः were delighted.

40014394.author: Translation
40014394.content: "Oh King Plunging into the ocean, which was in the shape of Yama's realm, with an enormous alligator in the form of rod of death, adorned with Salmali trees, turbulent with a huge wave in the form of Death 's noose, infested with Lord of  Death's attendants as serpents, unassailable on account of the mighty Jwara (spirit of fever), you have obtained a great victory over the Lord of Death 's great army and the army was warded off. By your good battle all the people (of the world) were delighted.

40014395.author: पदार्थः
40014395.content: क्षत्रियैर्: warriors, आसीद: was, बहुभि: many, र्वीरैः strong, शक्रतुल्यपराक्रमैः with courage equal to Indra, आसीद्: was, वसुमती: Earth, पूर्णा: fully, महद्भिरिव: like great, पादपैः trees

40014395.author: Translation
40014395.content: "The earth was fully filled with Kshatriya heroes of great prowess, equal to Indra in war who stood like trees on earth."

40014396.author: पदार्थः
40014396.content: तेषाम्: to them, वीर्यगुणोत्साहै: valour, excellence and energy, न: not, समो: equal, राघवो: Raghava, प्रसह्य: were overpowered, त्वया: by you, राजन्: King, हता: Killed, समरदुर्जयाः who were difficult to be overpowered.

40014396.author: Translation
40014396.content: "Raghava is not equal to them in valour, excellence and energy. Those warriors who were difficult to overcome by battle were overpowered and killed by you."

40014397.author: पदार्थः
40014397.content: तिष्ठ: you stay, किम्: why, महाराज: Oh great king तव: your, श्रमेण: by exertion, वानरान्: the monkeys, अयम्: this, एको: alone, महाबाहु: strong armed, इन्द्रजित्: Indrajith (Elder son of Ravana) क्षपयिष्यति: can destroy.

40014397.author: Translation
40014397.content: "Oh great king, you stay here calmly. Why exert yourself? This strong armed Indrajith alone can destroy those Vanaras."

40014398.author: पदार्थः
40014398.content: अनेन: by him, महाराज: great king, महेश्वर: Lord Maheshwara (Siva), अनुत्तमम्: supreme इष्ट्वायज्ञं: performing sacrifice, लब्धो: obtained, लोके: in the world, परमदुर्लभः very difficult, वरो: boon.

40014398.author: Translation
40014398.content: "Oh Great King By performing supreme sacrifices, Indrajith obtained boons from Lord Maheswara, which are very difficult to get."

40014399.author: पदार्थः
40014399.content: शक्ति: a powerful weapon like spear, तोमर: javelin, मीनंच: and fish, विनिकीर्णान्त्र: throwing entrails, शैवलम्: mossa water plant, गज: elephants, कछप: tortoises सम्बाध: connected, अश्व: horses, मण्डूक: frogs, संकुलम्: filled with, रुद्रा: Rudras, आदित्य: Adityas, महाग्राहं: huge alligator, मरुद्व: Marudas, सुमहोरगम्: huge serpents, रथश्व: Chariots tied to horses, गज: elephants, तोयौघं: volume of water, पदाति: footsoldiers, पुलिनं: sand beaches, महत्: large, अनेनहि: by him, समासाद्य: encountered, देवानां: of Devas, बलसागरम्: great ocean of army, गृहीतो: captured, दैवतपति: Lord of Devas (Indra), लङ्काच: in Lanka, प्रवेशितः entered.

40014399.author: Translation
40014399.content: Encountering with this army the ocean-like host of the gods—with spears and javelins for fish, scattered entrails for moss, elephants and tortoises, horses and frogs, Rudras and Adityas for huge crocodiles, Maruts and Vasus for great serpents, chariots, horses and elephants for its flood of water, and foot-soldiers for its sandbanks—he captured the lord of the gods, Indra, and brought him into Lanka.

40014400.author: पदार्थः
40014400.content: शक्ति: a powerful weapon like spear, तोमर: javelin, मीनंच: and fish, विनिकीर्णान्त्र: throwing entrails, शैवलम्: mossa water plant, गज: elephants, कछप: tortoises सम्बाध: connected, अश्व: horses, मण्डूक: frogs, संकुलम्: filled with, रुद्रा: Rudras, आदित्य: Adityas, महाग्राहं: huge alligator, मरुद्व: Marudas, सुमहोरगम्: huge serpents, रथश्व: Chariots tied to horses, गज: elephants, तोयौघं: volume of water, पदाति: footsoldiers, पुलिनं: sand beaches, महत्: large, अनेनहि: by him, समासाद्य: encountered, देवानां: of Devas, बलसागरम्: great ocean of army, गृहीतो: captured, दैवतपति: Lord of Devas (Indra), लङ्काच: in Lanka, प्रवेशितः entered.

40014401.author: पदार्थः
40014401.content: शक्ति: a powerful weapon like spear, तोमर: javelin, मीनंच: and fish, विनिकीर्णान्त्र: throwing entrails, शैवलम्: mossa water plant, गज: elephants, कछप: tortoises सम्बाध: connected, अश्व: horses, मण्डूक: frogs, संकुलम्: filled with, रुद्रा: Rudras, आदित्य: Adityas, महाग्राहं: huge alligator, मरुद्व: Marudas, सुमहोरगम्: huge serpents, रथश्व: Chariots tied to horses, गज: elephants, तोयौघं: volume of water, पदाति: footsoldiers, पुलिनं: sand beaches, महत्: large, अनेनहि: by him, समासाद्य: encountered, देवानां: of Devas, बलसागरम्: great ocean of army, गृहीतो: captured, दैवतपति: Lord of Devas (Indra), लङ्काच: in Lanka, प्रवेशितः entered.

40014401.author: Translation
40014401.content: Encountering with this army the ocean-like host of the gods—with spears and javelins for fish, scattered entrails for moss, elephants and tortoises, horses and frogs, Rudras and Adityas for huge crocodiles, Maruts and Vasus for great serpents, chariots, horses and elephants for its flood of water, and foot-soldiers for its sandbanks—he captured the lord of the gods, Indra, and brought him into Lanka.

40014402.author: पदार्थः
40014402.content: राजन्: king पितामहनियोगाच्च: ordered by creator Brahma, मुक्तः liberated, शम्बरवृत्रहा: the destroyer of Sambara and Vrtra (Indra): सर्वदेवनमस्कृतः adored by all Devas. गतस्त्रिविष्ट: returned to heaven.

40014402.author: Translation
40014402.content: "Liberated by the command of creator Brahma, Indra the destroyer of Sambara and Vrtra entered heaven was adorned and greeted by all Devas."
